always: Hero is a saturated, clearly named local color (blue, red, yellow, teal, orange-red) set against a different-hue, equally saturated background; hero and background are about equally loud, with almost no neutral rest area.
Hero and background sit in separate hue families, usually near-complementary pairs: blue on orange or pink, yellow on purple, red on green, red on blue, teal on orange, magenta on sand.
Backgrounds are flat or gently graded fields of one hue (purple, pink, orange, green, blue) with concentric rings, stripes or a faint icon pattern. They are not neutral.
Neutrals appear only in small amounts: cream or white panels and soles, grey stone, rocks, cap rims. Large muted areas are rare.

In the 8-colour lens, shadows keep their hue family and turn darker and slightly more saturated: deeper blue on blue, maroon on red, plum on purple, dark teal on teal. Where the floor is warm, cast shadows go brown, mauve or pink.
Each card shows 2 to 4 main hue families, plus tiny accents such as lace, flags and pins.
varies: Warm share: ticket and boxing-glove cards are roughly 60-80% warm. Pillow, fins and phone booth are about 30-50%. The garden card is mixed and the pump card is very warm.
Chroma: a few cards sit slightly lower, namely the shoes' pale yellow floor, the palm's sand and the pump's dusty sunset sky. Most cards are near full saturation.
Background type: some are abstract fields (ticket, pillow, fins, carousel). Others are real scenes with natural muted tones (wood, sand, stone, sky, pool).
Palette count is lowest on the pillow, fins and gloves, with 2 to 3 families. It is highest on the shoes, journal, bar and garden, with 5 or more.
Shadow quality: the soft pink and mauve shadows on pale floors and the dark brown shadows under wood are quite different from the saturated blue-on-blue shading on abstract-background cards.
never: A desaturated, grey or sepia hero.
A hero that matches its background hue.
Black or neutral-grey shadows; shadows always carry hue.
A whole card pulled to one warm cast with no cool counterpart.
A muted, low-chroma background framing a loud hero.
generator_wording: Hero in clear, saturated local colour (blue, red, yellow, teal) on a different-hue, equally saturated background: purple, pink, orange, green or blue, often with rings or stripes. Include only small cream, white or grey neutrals. Shadows are deeper, richer versions of the object's own hue, never black or grey. Use 2-4 hue families and keep warm and cool both present.
